image_alt: Portrait of a fawn and white whippet sitting on a cushion in front of rose-patterned wallpaper, looking at the camera.

text.facebook: Bonfire Night is less than four weeks away. This week PDSA called for fireworks to be limited to licensed public displays, saying their unpredictability is the biggest challenge for pets. Vets say start preparing now, not on the night. My tip: walk in daylight and be home before dark, and set up a cosy den this week so your dog knows it well by 5 November. Five things to do now: https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/fireworks-and-dogs
